scope: All six canonical bestiary profiles; no canonical miniboss profile exists. Future profiles must have both events.

intentional_reuse.reason: Preserve established porcelain shatter and its original CC0 provenance.
Preserve build0.62.0 assets byte-for-byte, variants, gains and pools.
Existing original hurt/collapse designed for this boss; profile-ready only, no playable encounter.

event_contract.hit: Only positive actual HP reduction leaving HP above zero; alternate variants without gameplay RNG; actor-local cooldown using paused simulation time.
event_contract.death: Only first guarded actual defeat; lethal damage emits death only, bypasses hit cooldown. No corpse, despawn, restore, offscreen or zero-damage playback.
event_contract.pools: Separate bounded hit/death pools per creature; death tails may outlive actor. Flushfiend retains four death voices; all others two hit/two death.
event_contract.lifecycle: Freeze on pause, stop and clear cooldowns on retry/respawn/title/dispose; SFX mute applies, music-only mute does not. Audio never gates gameplay.
event_contract.swarm: Continuous ambient buzz remains separate; HP damage and defeat events must also route through this profile.

validation.runtime: Engineering reports 12 packaged suites and 15 Python tests passed; all five implemented enemy audio paths covered. Clogfather references validated only.
validation.preserved_asset_hashes: passed: existing Sputtervalve, Clogfather and Flushfiend manifest cues unchanged

consultation.art: Confirmed six canonical profiles and no canonical miniboss omissions.
consultation.storyboarding: No identity/tone conflicts: nonhuman Widow without heavenly implication; Gratecrawler material sounds add no origin; swarm dispersal adds no organized behavior.
consultation.engineering: Schema agreed; generic controller, generated validation and build integration owned by Engineering.
